messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance window - Saturday 18 Oct
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 18 October between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close any open documents beforehand. Email will not be affected.

IT Helpdesk
